test_title: PYST 33: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting on a bench facing the interactive board in the classroom. A is sitting second to the right of B, while F is second to the right of E. If C is second right of A, then what is the sitting position of D in respect of F?
solution:
The logic follows here is :

Case (i) :

1) A is sitting second to the right of B

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/857575acadc56292100f2f1f94f233162258c22a8877b51d2e0c0c2e2e331264.png] 

2) If C is second right of A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43377b7ff748d41978d1db477ef07d1504d42b4050adc41bcc342395e2f5f0a2.png] 

3) While F is second to the right of E

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d927b2e2b665127495c2e8edc4fb62d70c8854d91f258a531d1eb66b25391c1a.png] 

Then the position of 'D' is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce3ef8b5c9efcf75a6b3578ae2928af3ad0633e3f2b84f13f6d01c79eb23be3e.png] 

In this case, "D is fourth left of F".

This statement is not present in options so it will be eliminated.

Case (ii):

1) A is sitting second to the right of B

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a621bcbb74ba74fb2f55659a8793c41cb60c8616a5ec3a9b228da5d4dfb8336.png] 

2) If C is second right of A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34c63074d46639f2090caa8c75f4bf763383b26bff749fe8d0fffb9243f612f2.png] 

3) While F is second to the right of E

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9a89ce02e02e87f26335c9fd2f69f9488389815035faf81c6d693394d8b786.png] 

Then the position of 'D' is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dcc5c0bb017e9dabd15b67c364699c52f0a9170a8c7d2c4d5e3ca6fb0a841ed.png] 

In this case, **"D is second right of F".**

Hence, sitting position of D is second right in respect of F.

Thus, the correct answer is **"Second right"**.
